purpose: for the reading (pāṭhārtha) of Rājā Indrasena
notes: The colophon gives two dates, Śaka 1482 ('sisāke' = śrīśāke) and VS 1617 ('saṃvat'). They agree: both fall in 1560 CE (Kārttika śukla 12 ≈ Oct/Nov 1560). Kārttika śukla 12 with the moon in Uttarabhādrapadā is astronomically plausible. The scribe's name is unclear. 'sipāḍe kavara' could be a corruption of 'Pāṇḍe Kaṃvara/Kuṃvara', as the cataloguer suggests, or 'sipāḍe' could be an occupational title such as sipāhī ('soldier'). Mahibola is given as the scribe's place of residence (vāstavya). It is not explicitly the place of copying, and it has not been identified. Indrasena is presumably a Sena ruler (Makwanpur/Palpa line), but he is not identified beyond the colophon. The phrase 'vivāha rocaya sarvagraṃtha ‥ bhāvasamucayapātha samāpata' seems to refer to other texts in the same codex and contains no further persons.
